exact_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: faithful Silent Storm source-painted particle COLOR texture, higher resolution edit.

Image1 is the exact ENTIRE original storedRGB texture exposed by whole nearest-neighbor source-only enlargement. Output the identical complete opaqueRGB canvas, edge-to-edge with the SAME normalized UV, source size/placement/softness and every original black gap. Very subtly refine only existing source paint; keep the same low-resolution artwork/material and relative weak local shading. Source alpha is independently retained and final brightness globally calibrated numerically. This is a flat source diffuse texture, not a scene, object render or invented interpretation.

Keep exactly ONE broad original softly blurred grayblue feather-color mass below the complete canvas center. Preserve its existing rounded upper shoulder, slightly irregular sides, weak lower taper/tails and muted blue-gray center in precisely the same source footprint. The native source has NO resolved feather shaft/barbs or fine fiber anatomy: do NOT create them, and do not turn the field into a realistic feather/cauliflower/smoke swirl. Keep the same complete soft paint blur, original grayblue tint and source relative weak shading, no centered white spot/core, crisp boundary, highlights or additional pieces.

Keep the original native blur and restrained palette, the exact original component count/positions/size and local bright-to-dim relationships. No new shapes, brighter centered cores, sparks/flecks/glints, rays, curl/cauliflower turbulence, cracks, folds, veins, fiber/barb/shaft anatomy, pores, photo grain, wet geometry, edge highlight or sharpened luminous outline. Do not turn unresolved native color transitions into new physical detail. Preserve the original soft paint scale instead of sharpening features.

Output ENTIRE opaque storedRGB source canvas only. No zoom/crop/padding/frame/recenter/repacking/autobbox/cutout/newtransparentbackground. Whole original alpha restored separately; preserve usefulRGB even where original alpha0.

source_transform_recipe.operations: Native stored RGBA→opaqueRGB, wholecanvas NEAREST16x. No crop/padding/rotate/UV fitting/unpremultiply/art inserted. SourceA separately restored by root.
source_transform_recipe.inverse: ENTIRE raw LANCZOS to original4x; sourceA LANCZOS separately; scalar brightness and original native Type handling by root.

prompt_serialization: Exact actual built-in prompt UTF-8 argument including CRLF equals prompt file bytes; references portable identities resolved against current repo root.
